name: Weekly social content planner
why: Plans next week's posts from last week's numbers with hooks checked, the same loop as the weekly social cycle in this kit.

name: Monthly content repurposer
why: Picks last month's best pieces and turns them into posts, emails and clips to approve, like the one-idea-many-platforms prompt at scale.

name: X and LinkedIn post pair writer
why: Writes separate X and LinkedIn versions of one idea, in line with the platform-native rule that posts are never pasted across.

name: Video opening line batch writer
why: Ten different video hooks and the two to film first, a companion to the video-hook-batch prompt.

name: Short video hook writer
why: Hooks checked for length, reading level and first shot, matching the hook step in the short-video-scripts skill.

name: Short video format picker
why: Picks a repeatable video format for who is on camera, the first step of the short-video-scripts skill.

name: Social video edit planner
why: Turns clips and an idea into a timed cut list, captions and a cover, for when the client has footage to edit.

name: Reusable Reel cover recipe builder
why: A repeatable cover style for Reels, so a batch shoot ends with a consistent grid.

name: Social comment and reply desk
why: Drafts replies that add something and collects repeat questions, the core of the comment-and-message-replies skill.

name: Weekly community keeper
why: A weekly pass over community posts and questions with useful replies, for groups and communities as well as comments.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks every promise in a complaint reply before it goes out, the rule this kit sets for replies and holding statements.

name: Public review reply desk
why: Checked replies to public reviews with risky ones held, the same hold-for-a-person approach used for social comments.

name: Brand social account checker
why: Scores accounts and posts against rules with a fix for each, useful before the monthly plan and review.

name: Influencer gifting planner
why: Plans gifting and tracking; pair it with the disclosure-and-claims-check prompt so every gifted post is labelled.
